sdk.title: Client SDK Integration (tm-hub-client)
sdk.description: Client applications in the ecosystem (such as {app}) connect to TM Hub via the unified client library:

api.title: REST API Specifications (v1)
api.login: Authenticate user with email/password, returns Access & Refresh Tokens
api.refresh: Refresh Access Token using a valid Refresh Token
api.me: Fetch currently authenticated user account profile
api.routes: Fetch navigation route tree filtered by user role (RBAC)
api.getConfigs: Retrieve all 3rd-party configs (AI, Cloudinary, Firebase, Push)
api.updateConfigs: Update service configuration parameters for the application
api.getMediaFolders: List Cloudinary folders for the specified appId
api.getMediaResources: List media assets inside a specific folder
api.getMediaSignature: Generate secure backend signature for direct client uploads to Cloudinary
api.subscribeNotification: Register Web Push subscription for the authenticated user
api.getNotifications: Retrieve notifications list for the user
api.sendNotification: Dispatch Web Push notification to target users

Hello everyone! This is the All-in-One Text Processing Workbench.
Supported features:
- Case conversion: UPPERCASE, lowercase, Sentence case, Capitalize Words.
- Code naming: camelCase, kebab-case, snake_case, CONSTANT_CASE.
- Remove accents & generate SEO-friendly URL slugs.
- Clean extra whitespace, filter empty lines, sort lines A-Z.
- Encode & decode Base64, URL Encoding, HTML Entities.
